intro: Professionals and everyday users convert acres (ac) to hectares (ha) when working across imperial and metric standards in real estate property deeds, agricultural land surveying, commercial floor plan leases, and civil zoning. One acre equals 0.404686 hectares, while 1 hectare equals 2.471054 acres. Whether you are verifying area specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Exact NIST Factor vs. Early Rounding Drift
items: The exact conversion factor from Acre to Hectare is 0.40468564, derived from the 1959 International Yard and Pound Agreement (1 inch = 25.4 mm, 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg).

In structural engineering, CNC machining, or bulk inventory totals, rounding the multiplier to 2 decimal places too early can introduce cumulative tolerance errors; always compute with the full factor and round only the final displayed figure.

faqs.question: How many hectares (ha) are in 1 acre (ac)?
faqs.answer: There are 0.40468564 hectares (ha) in 1 acre (ac), which rounds to 0.4047 ha for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 hectare equals 2.471054 acres.

faqs.question: How do I convert acres to hectares (ac to ha)?
faqs.answer: To convert acres to hectares, use the formula: ha = ac × 0.40468564. For example, converting 10 ac gives 4.0469 ha.

faqs.question: What is 10 acres in hectares?
faqs.answer: 10 acres (ac) equals exactly 4.0469 hectares (ha) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
